description: This file defines interfaces and types related to GPIO-based FSIO (Flexible Input/Output) operations in a firmware project. It includes type definitions, macro constants, and function prototypes for initializing, configuring, and retrieving FSIO states.

methods.name: getEngineValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the engine based on a specified action and engine parameters.

methods.name: setFsio
methods.description: Sets the FSIO pin state or value based on an expression.

methods.name: setFsioExt
methods.description: Sets the FSIO pin with an external PWM frequency, configured via an expression.

methods.name: initFsioImpl
methods.description: Initializes FSIO implementation with a shared logger context.

methods.name: runFsio
methods.description: Executes periodic FSIO processing based on the current engine parameters.

methods.name: getFsioOutputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current output value of a specified FSIO channel.

methods.name: applyFsioConfiguration
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to the FSIO system based on the current engine parameters.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeFsioCallback
methods.description: Callback function triggered when the engine configuration changes, to update FSIO accordingly.
